name: Southampton Hot Tub
category: Hot tubs, swim spas, and saunas
address: 344 N Pottstown Pike, Suite 100, Exton, PA 19341 (also 725 County Line Rd, Huntingdon Valley, PA 19006)
description: Southampton Hot Tub is a family-owned and operated dealer with showrooms in Exton and Huntingdon Valley, an authorized retailer of Jacuzzi, Bullfrog Spas, Sundance, and Artesian Spas, plus saunas and cold plunges.
tagline: Hot tubs, swim spas, and saunas, two showrooms

hero.eyebrow: Exton and Huntingdon Valley, PA | Family owned
hero.headline: Hot tubs and saunas, two showrooms
hero.sub: Family-owned and operated, an authorized Jacuzzi, Bullfrog, Sundance, and Artesian retailer, with saunas, swim spas, and cold plunges on the same floors.

offerings.heading: Everything that holds <mark>warm water.</mark>
items: Hot tubs from Jacuzzi, Bullfrog Spas, Sundance, and Artesian Spas
Swim spas, LeisureCraft and Sun & Soul saunas, and Kodiak cold plunges
Maintenance, winterization, repairs, and relocation by certified technicians
Authorized Jacuzzi, Bullfrog, Sundance, and Artesian retailer
Serving Bucks, Montgomery, Chester, and Delaware counties
Showrooms in Exton and Huntingdon Valley

story.heading: A family business in two counties
paragraphs: Southampton Hot Tub started as a family operation and still runs like one, with showrooms in Exton and Huntingdon Valley.
The brands on the floor are the ones the family would put in its own backyard.

experience.heading: Buying and owning
items: Wet-test and compare models in a showroom.
Delivery, placement, and relocations by the same team.
Winterization in the fall, restarts in spring, repairs in between.

feature.heading: Saunas and cold plunges
feature.text: LeisureCraft and Sun & Soul saunas sit beside Kodiak cold plunges, so a backyard can run hot and cold in the same corner.

spotlight.heading: Service and relocation
spotlight.text: Certified technicians handle maintenance, seasonal service, repairs, and relocations across four counties.

closing.heading: Family-owned, two showrooms, every major spa brand
